title: Salt & Light | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Gulf Front + Private Pool + Community Beach Access- Salt & Light by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Salt & Light by Royal Destinations Location: Seacrest Beach (Between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach) Address: 108 Longue Vue Drive, Inlet Beach, FL 32461 Details: Nestled between the highly coveted 30A communities of Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, Salt & Light is a perfectly positioned Gulf front home in a private, gated cul-de-sac. With over 6, 200 square feet of modern, Gulf front luxury, this 30A luxury home boasts a pristine, community beach. Whether you are taking a dip in the saltwater pool or escaping to one of the multiple private suites, this is the vacation of a lifetime. There is an abundance of outdoor living that can be enjoyed in the quiet private, gated courtyard, the generous pool terrace, or the balcony of your primary suite. Guests searching for 30A vacation rentals with private pools are sure to be wowed. The interior of the home is no less spectacular with 3 kitchens, multiple laundry areas, an elevator, and a courtyard carriage house. The only thing missing is you! If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: - Distance to Beach Access: Gulf Front - Community Beach Access - *Private Heated Pool - *Available for monthly rentals - Main House and Courtyard Residence - Over 6,200 Sq Ft - Parking Spaces: (4) in Driveway + (2) Midsize vehicles in garage - Dining Accommodations *Pool Heat is available for an additional $330 (pre-tax). *The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. *Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. *Contact our team for winter monthly rental rates. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 16 6.5 Bedrooms / 5 Baths / 2 Half Baths First Floor Courtyard Residence: 1.5 Bedrooms / 1 Bath / 1 Half Courtyard Bath - King Bed, Twin Sleeper Chair - Hallway Bunk Bed (Twin/Twin) - Living/Full Kitchen/Dining Main House: 5 Beds | 4 Full Baths | 1 Half Bath Second Floor: - Bedroom 2: King Bed, with Private Bath (Shower), Balcony Overlooking Courtyard - Chefs Kitchen / Living Room / Dining Area / Office / Walk-In Pantry - Half Bath Third Floor: - Bedroom 3: King Bed (Primary), Gulf-side Balcony, Panoramic Views, Living Area, Private Bath (Shower) - Bedroom 4: King Bed, Shared Bath, (Shower) - Bedroom 5: Twin/Full Bunk Room, Shared Bath (Shower) - Bedroom 6: Queen Bed, Private Bath (Tub/Shower Combo) - Half Kitchen Amenities Include: - 8 Adult Bikes - 2 Beach Service Sets Seasonally (Available through Longue Vue Beach Service. No personal chairs allowed.) - Beach Towel Service Please Note: *Nearby construction is underway. *Beach service is available for rent through Longue Vue Beach Service. No personal chairs are allowed. *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. *The master bedroom fireplace and home surround sound are not functional. *No Golf Carts Allowed Per HOA Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
